summary: Layout labels for PDF pages 320-352 of the Warburg 1853 German print (printed pages 316-348). Book III ends on PDF 322; BOOK IV BEGINS ON PDF PAGE 323 (printed 319) with its title block and the heading of chapter 1. These pages cover Book IV chapters 1-14 (chapter 14 continues past PDF 352). LETTER SQUARES APPEAR ONLY ON PDF PAGES 324-337 (chapters 1, 2 and 3); from chapter 4 onward every numbered item is followed by a list of word-like names instead of a square, so pages 338-352 contain no squares. Arrangement is strictly vertical, never side by side: a caption line (sometimes 2-3 printed lines) sits above its square, the square occupies its own band or run of bands, and a cross-reference line may follow above or below. No caption and no square ever share a band in this range, so caption crops cannot contain square letters. Some caption bands do carry a smaller cross-reference sub-line or a cross-reference set to the right on the same line (pages 326, 336): that is text only. Band ranges for squares are often longer than one band because the grid's horizontal rules break the ink projection - pages 327 (bands 4-7), 333 (3-5), 335 (5-8) and above all 337 (bands 3-16) each hold exactly ONE square across those bands. Counts: 18 square blocks and 80 caption blocks. Squares are numbered 1-11 in chapter 1 (pages 324-331), 1-3 in chapter 2 (pages 332-334), 1-4 in chapter 3 (pages 335-337). Five of them carry no printed number (chapter 2 items 1 and 3, chapter 3 items 3 and 4) and are inferred from order; those four blocks say so in their note. Every band on every page is assigned to exactly one block, in reading order. x is measured from the rasterised page (the 60 px label margin excluded) as the ink extent of the block's bands plus ~1.2% padding. No square letters were transcribed or described anywhere in this file.
